spans.s: + जिह्व स्थिर- + जिह्व, m. a fish.
+ दंष्ट्र स्थिर- + दंष्ट्र, m. 1. A snake. 2. Viṣṇu in the boar avatāra.
+ प्रेमन् स्थित- + प्रेमन्, m. a faithful friend.
+ मनस् स्थिर- + मनस्, adj. having a faithful mind or heart, Pañc. 107, 11.
+ यौवन स्थिर- + यौवन, adj., f. ना, possessed of eternal youth, Vikr. d. 109.
+ लोचन स्थिर- + लोचन, adj. with fixed gaze.

+ स्थापक स्थिति- + स्थापक,
 I. adj. who or what fixes (cf. स्थिति).
 II. m. (n., Wils.), elasticity, Bhāṣāp. 95; 156 (cf. स्थिति).
स्थिक, i. e. स्थ + क, m. A buttock.

स्थिति, i. e. स्था + ति, f.
 1. Standing,

. Remaining, Pañc. pr. d. 8 (गर्भे, in the womb, i. e. not being brought forth).

; condition, Pañc. 124, 4; natural state (cf. -स्थापक, Bhāṣāp. 95, properly ‘restoring the natural state’).
 8. Correctness of conduct,

. Stop, cessation.
 11. Limit, boundary.
 12. A sure decision,

स्थिति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Firm, stable, Vikr. d. 160.
 2. Virtuous,

स्थिर, i. e. स्था + र,
 I. adj., comparat. स्थेयंस्, superl. स्थेष्ठ.
 1. Firm, Vikr. d. 1; fixed, immovable,

(स्थिरी कृ, To stop, Pañc. 258, 20).
 2. Permanent, Vikr. d. 109;

. Faithful, Pañc. 107, 11.
 II. m.
 1. A deity.
 2. Final emancipation.
 3. A mountain.
 4. A tree.
 5. A bull.
 6. Kārttikeya, the god of war.
 7. Saturn.
 III. f. रा.
 1. The earth.
 2. Silk-cotton tree, and two other plants.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. στηρίζω, στερεός, στεῤῥός, στελεόν; Lat. stolidus, stultus; O.H.G. starên; A.S. starian; O.H.G. storrên, stornên, starh; A.S. starc; O.H.G. ga-starkên, starhjan, etc.

स्थिर + ता, f.
 1. Firmness, Śāk. d. 90; stability; स्थिरतां नी, To secure, Pañc. 97, 14.
 2. Moral firmness.
 3. Fortitude.
स्थिर + त्व, n. Firmness, steadiness, Johns.
